svg.desc: Follow the numbered connectors. Subnumbers identify branches or smaller steps. Optional actions and supporting relationships are labeled separately. The workspace has a schema explorer and a question-and-answer area. Users browse table names, ask questions, watch progress, optionally cancel, then inspect the SQL, answer, or error. A successful table can be explored and downloaded without rerunning the query.
svg.title: Frontend — what the reader sees and does

g.text: Search or refresh the table list
Question area: Ask or follow up
While the app works: Watch progress
Result table: Sort, page, and resize
